sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 231862 (search/campsites API, read 2026-10-28)

values.note: Spurs range from 25 to 40 ft; the FS page gives 46 ft as the maximum vehicle length at 3 sites. Single and double sites, plus walk-to tent sites. RVs and extra vehicles must fit on the spur; no off-road parking. The catalog lists 105 of the 129 sites, with 6 pull-throughs in Loops B and C.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/stillwater-campground ('There are 129 sites ... spurs range from 25 to 40 feet in length'; 'Maximum Vehicle Length: 46' (3 sites).') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231862 ('It offers 129 sites ... spurs range from 25 to 40 feet in length') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('Stillwater | 129 | 40’ | Reserve Now') + catalog (Max Vehicle Length up to 40; B002, B003, B084, B085, B086, C095 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Electric and water only at the 21 electric sites, all in Loop A (18 reservable, 3 first come). The catalog lists 30 amps at every one; a recreation.gov notice says 'Amperage is variable with choices of 20, 30, and 50 amps.'

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 231862 (21 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, all Loop A: Electricity Hookup 30, Water Hookup Y) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231862 ('RV water connections are only available on sites with electric hookups. RV connections are not available at the non-electric sites.'; '129 sites, 21 of which have electric hookups') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/stillwater-campground ('Twenty-one of these sites have electric hookups'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Boat ramp and dock on site (the Stillwater ramp was closed for low water in 2026), amphitheater, campground host. Little to no shade.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231862 ('Flush and vault toilets, showers, drinking water and a dump station are provided.'; 'A boat ramp and dock are located on-site.'; 'the campground has little to no shade') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/arapaho-national-recreation-area ('Stillwater Ramp is closed due to low water levels.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Loop A May 15 - Oct 11; Loops B and C May 15 - Sept 20.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Sulphur Ranger District Campground Status: Stillwater, Operating Season 'A Loop: May 15 - Oct 11 B & C Loop: May 15 - Sept 20'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Most sites reservable on recreation.gov up to 4 days before arrival; the rest first come, first served. Up to 7 consecutive nights per reservation; no site-swapping. A reserved site not occupied within 26 hours goes first come. 2026 reservation season May 15 - Oct 10. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231862 (rules reservationCutOff 4 days, maxConsecutiveStay 7; notices 'You must stay in the campsite you reserved. Site-swapping is not allowed.', 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours', 'Check-Out is at 12 P.M. Check-In is at 2 P.M.') + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-10) + catalog (reservable and not-reservable sites in each loop), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 2026: non-electric and walk-to sites $32, a few premium non-electric sites $38, Loop A electric $43, double sites $67-73. One vehicle included; extra vehicles $8 a night. An Arapaho National Recreation Area pass is also required ($5 a day, $10 three days, $15 a week, $30 a year on recreation.gov); an Interagency Pass covers it.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231862/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-10: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 32, STANDARD ELECTRIC 43, WALK TO 32, doubles 67/73, a 38 template on B066, B088-B090, C092; 2027 the same) + catalog price_range per site + notice ('$8.00 per vehicle per night') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/stillwater-campground ('Single Site: $32 per night (walk to), $38 per night (non-electric), $43 per night (electric) / Double Site: $67'; 'The Arapaho National Recreation fee also applies') + ANRA pass prices as published in recreation.gov's notice for Arapaho Bay (231860), read 2026-10-28

note: Arapaho NF (Sulphur RD) in the Arapaho National Recreation Area, on a peninsula on Lake Granby's north shore, 8 mi north of Granby off US-34, ~8,300 ft. The sites along the peninsula's south and east shore sit at the water. --Claude
summary: FS page + forest status table + recreation.gov + catalog: confirmed 30-amp/water at the 21 Loop A electric sites (public-bookable), $32-43, reservable. Changed max_rig_ft 47 -> 46 (FS: 46 ft at 3 sites; spurs 25-40). Added 129 sites, pull-throughs, showers/flush+vault toilets/water/dump, season May 15 - Oct 11 (B & C loops to Sept 20), booking (4-day cutoff, 7-night max, reservation season May 15 - Oct 10), ANRA pass in fees.note. flags: Phone missing: Sulphur Ranger District Office 970-295-6600 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/offices). recreation.gov's '(530) 529-0578' is the concessionaire's facility line.

Length conflict: FS page 'Maximum Vehicle Length: 46' (3 sites)' vs 'spurs range from 25 to 40 feet' (FS page and recreation.gov) and the status table's 'Max Spur 40’'; the catalog's per-site maximum is 40. Recorded 46 (the FS page's stated maximum); all clear EKKO.

Fee conflict: the FS page says '$38 per night (non-electric)' and '$32 (walk to)'; recreation.gov's 2026 rate table charges $32 for STANDARD NONELECTRIC and $38 only at five sites (B066, B088, B089, B090, C092). Recorded recreation.gov's $32 base.
Amperage: catalog 30 at all 21 electric sites; a recreation.gov notice says 'Amperage is variable with choices of 20, 30, and 50 amps.' Kept 30 (snap down).
Site count: 129 on FS, recreation.gov and the status table; the catalog lists only 105 sites.

Waterfront (stored lakefront, confirmed for part of the campground): on imagery the campground fills a peninsula with Lake Granby on three sides; the string of sites along the east lobe's south and east shore is ~10-20 m from the waterline across open sand/grass, and the southwest loop ~30-60 m across open ground. The catalog has no site coordinates, so which loop letter holds the shore sites was not settled. Lake Granby 2026 (USBR GRARESCO): 8,250.6 ft on May 1, 8,254.8 ft mid-June, 8,234.75 ft on Oct 26 (full pool ~8,280), so the water stood ~25-45 ft below full all season and the FS closed the Stillwater boat ramp 'due to low water levels'; under the open-apron rule drawdown does not downgrade.
Advisory (FS page): 'Due to work on Shadow Mountain Dam, there may be heavy equipment staged near the campground.' Not a closure.

Pin: stored 40.1816,-105.8911 (= recreation.gov's facility point) is at the US-34 entrance, ~300 m northwest of the campground's centre; the FS page's 40.1797,-105.8869 is inside the east loop. Better pin ~40.1800,-105.8880. Within 500 m.
Operator: concessionaire (recreation.gov facility line, Morrison CO address); ownership left federal.
